newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwaiti MPs retain seats in poll rerun.
newsitem.headline: Kuwaiti MPs retain seats in poll rerun.

text.p: Two Kuwaiti members of parliament retained their seats in a second round of polling held because of voting irregularities in the October general election, an official said on Thursday.

Waleed al-Jeri won 3,854 votes in Kuwait's 21st constituency in Wednesday's poll, Khaled al-Adwa came second with 3,804 votes and their challenger Saadoun al-Oteibi scored 3,545 votes, failing to secure a seat in the chamber of 50 elected deputies.
The Constitutional Court had ordered the rerun after Oteibi charged that military personnel, barred from voting by law, took part in voting in the constituency in October.
The court ruling in January froze the membership of the two seats.
